title: Peter the Great's reforms
summary: Peter I, tsar from 1682 and emperor from 1721 until his death in 1725, set out to put Russia on a level with the powers of Western Europe. In 1697-98 he toured the West on the Grand Embassy, working on ships himself. He built Russia's first navy, began industry and schools, taxed beards and ordered Western dress, replaced the patriarch with a synod under state control, and in 1722 introduced the Table of Ranks. In 1703 he founded St Petersburg as his new capital.
